title: Federal budget — actual spending 2024
basis: Cash actuals (Ist) of the core federal budget. Federal special funds (e.g. the defence fund) are separate accounts and not included.
method: Sum of all unique expenditure Titel (ein-aus-art 'ausgaben'/'flex-ausgaben', deduplicated by Einzelplan/Kapitel/Titelnummer), grouped by the first digit of the functional code (Funktionenplan Hauptfunktion). English group names are editorial translations; independently verified structure and totals, 2026-08-05.

groups.name: Social security
groups.description: The biggest block: the federal subsidy to the statutory pension insurance, citizens' benefit (Bürgergeld) and other labour-market spending, family benefits, war-related obligations.

groups.name: General services & defence
groups.description: Running the state: government and administration, the armed forces (defence pay and procurement in the core budget), police, courts, foreign affairs.

groups.name: Interest, debt & financial assets
groups.description: Interest on federal debt, repayments, guarantees, and the management of federal assets.

groups.name: Transport & communications
groups.description: Roads, railways (including federal payments to the rail system), waterways, digital infrastructure.

groups.name: Education, science & research
groups.description: Research funding, universities and student support (BAföG), vocational training, culture.

groups.name: Energy, business & services
groups.description: Energy and business support programmes paid from the core budget.

groups.name: Health, environment & sport
groups.description: Federal health programmes, environmental protection, sport funding.

groups.name: Housing & urban development
groups.description: Housing benefit, urban development, spatial planning.

groups.name: Food, agriculture & forests
groups.description: Agricultural policy and rural programmes in the federal budget.
